title: Not Sure Which Guide Fits Your Trip?

scenarios.title: First time in Japan?
scenarios.description: Start with the 7-Day Japan Blueprint — it covers Tokyo, Hakone, Kyoto, and Osaka in one document.

scenarios.title: Traveling in winter?
scenarios.description: Cold and snow? The 4-Day Okinawa Slow Travel guide is your warm-island escape — 22°C in January, half the crowds, half the price.

scenarios.title: Want to explore Tokyo in depth?
scenarios.description: The Tokyo 5-Day Route dives deep into every major district — Shibuya, Asakusa, Shinjuku, Akihabara and more.

scenarios.title: Chasing autumn colors?
scenarios.description: The Kyoto 3-Day Autumn Foliage Guide covers the best temple gardens and maple-lined paths with peak-timing tips.

scenarios.title: Just want a quick win?
scenarios.description: Grab the Kyoto Takao Three Temples guide for $1.99 — a secret maple-leaf valley locals love, done in half a day.
